src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/0b073b67f09d131a91dd8e09cb0ff8fb15baad27.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Damage[b]: Ranged;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Armor[b]: High;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Movement Range[b]: 3;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Attack Range: [b]5-10;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Movement Type: [b]Threads[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Cost: [b]9000;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Can only attack in a straight line, but will do [b]SPLASH DAMAGE[/b] to anyone between it and the target;
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b](NEW) MAGNET[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/202e97d435d7576ba63790c953b028c559623571.gif"][/img]  [/p][list][*][p]Damage[b]: None;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Armor[b]: Medium;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Movement Range[b]: 4;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Attack Range: [b]0;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Movement Type: [b]Threads[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Cost: [b]2500;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Can Slow down [b]nearby[/b] enemies;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) MEGA[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/024065e49ed75469c3112c5f856a93656497bb94.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Damage[b]: High;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Armor[b]: High;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Movement Range[b]: 4;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Attack Range: [b]1;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Movement Type: [b]Threads[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Cost: [b]8000;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Deals damage to [b]target[/b] and [b]3 tiles[/b] behind it with [b]SPLASH DAMAGE[/b]:[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) DEFENDER[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/db011706ebb57738017b6042109d8fd62c130136.gif"][/img]  [/p][list][*][p][b]Defender[/b] now gives [b]SHIELD STATUS EFFECT[/b] to nearby allies;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) FLAME[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/a7ab437202daf58da827c6c2ac46d75fbc62c473.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Flame[/b] now rolls a [b]BURN DIE[/b], with a chance of giving [b]BURN STATUS EFFECT[/b];[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) INFERNO[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/56f73256085ea515d84e01a1aec5cd99aacf2815.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Inferno[/b] now rolls a [b]BURN DIE[/b], with a chance of giving [b]BURN STATUS EFFECT[/b];[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inferno[/b] now can deal [b]BURN STATUS EFFECT[/b] to units behind the target;[/p][list][*][p]"Splash Damage" but only for [b]BURN;[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATE) ARTILLERY[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/40d226fe9bd1568fbe9421201b251c1df02538c4.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Artillery[/b] now deals [b]SPLASH DAMAGE in a plus shape;[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UNITS) FUTURE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]There are ideas to rework 2 extra units to match some new status effects;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b](NEW) SPLASH DAMAGE[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/b041803badbba5befcb01019ec224a935077dae2.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Some units now deal splash damage;[/p][list][*][p][b]ARTILLERY, MEGA[/b] and [b]LASER[/b];[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]SPLASH DAMAGE[/b] area is shown as a yellowish/orangeish area around the main target;[/p][/*][*][p][b]SPLASH DAMAGE[/b] will deal damage to [i][b]all [/b][/i]units inside the [b]SPLASH DAMAGE[/b] area (similar to Armstrong Special);[/p][list][*][p]Be aware not to damage your own units;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/dc6a39485a7e24a26738d19d976b992a3db1ff27.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]SPLASH DAMAGE [/b]is based on total damage given to the main target.[/p][list][*][p]Target: [b]100%[/b] of the damage (as usual);[/p][/*][*][p]Infantry Armor Units: [b]50%[/b] of the damage;[/p][/*][*][p]Low Armor Units: [b]33%[/b] of the damage;[/p][/*][*][p]Medium Armor Units: [b]25%[/b] of the damage;[/p][/*][*][p]High Armor Units: [b]20%[/b] of the damage;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](SPLASH DAMAGE) VISUALS[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/f3140049359d9adcf7bcc350289ae18b1bd57319.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]During battle, units that deal [b]SPLASH DAMAGE[/b] will spawn debris when attacking the target;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b](UPDATED AND NEW) BATTLE[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) BATTLE SPEED UP[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/3961cac681b6e75d32b231e80249e536d629698d.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Battles[/b] can be [b]speed up[/b] by press and holding [b]LMB[/b], [b]Spacebar[/b] or [b]A[/b] (on Gamepad) after throwing the dice;[/p][list][*][p]On [b]vs Computer, [/b]the speed up can happens immediately after you throw the dice, you don't need to wait for the AI;[/p][/*][*][p]On [b]PvP battles[/b], [b]both player need to hold the button[/b] for it to speed up after they throw the dice;[/p][/*][*][p]You could also release the button to return to normal speed;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) D20 VISUAL[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/b81c9d57e21712514d989cede6f27296fef4c923.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Our [b]D20 Die [/b]got a updated visual;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the + and - signs to be on top, so now they numbers are slightly bigger, making it easier to see on small screens (ex: laptops);[/p][list][*][p]This is a much needed update that I've always hear when showcasing the game on events;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dice has been slightly scaled up;[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the +- signs from 0s, since it didn't make sense;[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[b](NEW) D6 BURN DIE[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/17cda14b2e7393d2096a8f1a720a1761a826fd9d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Burn Die[/b]: 33% chance (D6 2 faces out of 6) of giving [b]BURN STATUS EFFECT[/b] to target![/p][/*][*][p][b]Burn Die[/b] is automatically played when [b]attacking[/b] with [b]FLAME [/b]or [b]INFERNO[/b] units;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) D6 SHOCK DIE[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/272d5d3dd1f94eda2908c29da053ecdf0f31f76b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Shock Die[/b]: 15% (1/6) chance of giving [b]SHOCK STATUS EFFECT[/b] to target![/p][/*][*][p][b]Shock Die[/b] is automatically played when [b]attacking[/b] with [b]SHOCKER[/b] unit;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](BATTLE) MINOR UPDATES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Overall visual quality[/b] improved;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Burn and Shock dice[/b] have [b]cool VFX[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Update [b]Throw Bar visuals[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Lighting on the Dice Box;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Commander Cards to have some extra details;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](BATTLE) FUTURE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]There are plans for a couple extra [b]DICE[/b] (that combo with new [b]STATUS EFFECTS[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Future Settings plans:[/p][list][*][p][b]Skip Throw Dice[/b]: Automatically throws dice and just show animations;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skip Battle if Insta-Kill[/b]: Automatically skip battle/dice/animations if it's gonna be a insta-kill;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fully Skip Battles: [/b]Fully Skips dice throw and battle animations. Will only update units health in the board and never show camera transitions to the battle arenas;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b](NEW) STATUS EFFECTS[/b][/h2][p]Well, we had status effects before (Amara's Special Slow down), but now they are a full fledged system![/p][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) SLOW DOWN[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/202e97d435d7576ba63790c953b028c559623571.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Status: [b]SLOW DOWN[/b][/p][list][*][p]Any units with [b]SLOW DOWN[/b] will have it's [b]movement range reduced by 2[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]Units with [b]SLOW DOWN[/b] have a blue arrow pointing down on them;[/p][/*][*][p]Minimum movement range will be [b]1 [/b](so units like Sniper (Movement Range 2) won't be fully rooted);[/p][/*][*][p][b]MAGNETs[/b] cannot receive [b]SLOW DOWN, [/b]not even by Amara's Special[b];[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]SLOW DOWN[/b] can be given to enemies through:[/p][list][*][p]Amara's Special (lasts 1 turn);[/p][/*][*][p]If you are adjacent to a enemy [b]MAGNET[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]Cannot be stacked;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]SLOW DOWN [/b]can be removed if:[/p][list][*][p][b]MAGNET [/b]unit is destroyed;[/p][/*][*][p]You move away from the [b]MAGNET[/b] area;[/p][/*][*][p](If Amara Special) After the turn ends;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) BURN[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/2f8ea56ac24b95a7946e17bc41117a3e7a443aae.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Status: [b]BURN[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]BURNED[/b] units will receive [b]2 damage per tile walked[/b];[/p][list][*][p]Staying in place will [b]not [/b]deal damage;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lasts 2 turns;[/p][/*][*][p]Units with [b]BURN [/b] will have a small fire attached to them;[/p][/*][*][p]It's not stackable, but it can be reset if applied again;[/p][/*][*][p][b]FLAMEs and INFERNOs[/b] cannot receive [b]BURN[/b];[/p][/*][*][p][b]BURN [/b]is given by [b]FLAME or INFERNO[/b] during battle with the [b]BURN DIE[/b];[/p][list][*][p][b]BURN and INFERNOS [/b]cannot roll a [b]BURN DIE[/b] when they are defending;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]BURN [/b]is removed automatically after 2 turns;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) SHIELD[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/db011706ebb57738017b6042109d8fd62c130136.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Status: [b]SHIELD[/b][/p][list][*][p]Units with [b]SHIELD [/b]have +10 Defense;[/p][/*][*][p]Units with [b]SHIELD[/b] have the shimmering effect on them;[/p][/*][*][p][b]SHIELD [/b]is given automatically to any ally units adjacent to the [b]DEFENDER [/b]unit;[/p][list][*][p]Units in a plus shape, up to 4 units (above, below, left and right);[/p][/*][*][p]Cannot be stacked;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]DEFENDERs[/b] cannot receive [b]SHIELD;[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]SHIELD[/b] can only be removed if:[/p][list][*][p][b]DEFENDER [/b]unit giving [b]SHIELD [/b]dies;[/p][/*][*][p]If you or the [b]DEFENDER [/b]move away from each other;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) SHOCK[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/0313d613ff628d9e11b9972654aa1127d7a6a837.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Status: [b]SHOCK[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]SHOCKED [/b]units won't be able to [b]move[/b], [b]attack[/b] or [b]counter-attack[/b] (last 1 turn);[/p][/*][*][p]It's not stackable;[/p][/*][*][p][b]SHOCKED [/b]units will become grayed out and have a small electricity sprite on them;[/p][/*][*][p][b]SHOCKERs [/b]cannot receive [b]SHOCK;[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]SHOCK[/b] is given by [b]SHOCKER[/b] unit during battle with the [b]SHOCK DIE[/b];[/p][list][*][p][b]SHOCKERs[/b] cannot roll a [b]SHOCK[/b] [b]DIE[/b] when they are defending;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]SHOCK [/b]is removed automatically after 1 turn;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b] (STATUS EFFECTS) EXTRAS[/b][/h3][p]
 Besides seeing what [b]STATUS EFFECT[/b] your unit has on the board, you can also check the Unit Info Card;
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/0c569e26507b557529be5253096e535cc041c736.png"][/img][/p][p](in order: [b]SHOCK, SLOW, SHIELD, BURN)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]For fun here is what a unit with all [b]STATUS EFFECTS[/b] looks like (although very rare, it could happen!)[/p][p]([i]very chaotic, I know[/i])[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/f8799a907fd8b18203d4371cd91f443e330798c9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b](STATUS EFFECTS) FUTURE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]There are plans for a couple extra [b]STATUS EFFECTS[/b];[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b](UPDATED AND NEW) ALL STRATEGISTS REVEALED[/b][/h2][p]Meet our full cast! For the demo, only the 3 already in will be playable in custom matches. But Story Mode (Prologue) you will be able to play with [i][b]almost[/b][/i] all of them![/p][p]
[i](in order)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Thaddeus Armstrong[/b], from the [b]Garnet Eagles[/b];[/p][list][*][p]General of the Army;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Reiko Hayashi[/b], from the [b]Jade Foxes;[/b][/p][list][*][p]CEO and Fashionista;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Amara Khumalo[/b], from the [b]Sapphire Lions;[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rocket Scientist;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ingrid Falk[/b], from the [b]Obsidian Ravens;[/b][/p][list][*][p]Prodigy Detective;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Vihaan Sharma[/b], from the [b]Amethyst Tiger;[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chess GrandMaster;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Omar Wahid[/b], from the [b]Spinal Cobras;[/b][/p][list][*][p]Retired Kingpin;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Agnes Holloway[/b], from the [b]Opal Sharks;[/b][/p][list][*][p]Historian and Archeologist;[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Kaique Ribeiro[/b], from the [b]Ruby Jaguars;[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hacker;[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/1f04b16d008bfb24a98c1d81d7807af2c254d53c.png"][/img][/p][p]There are still [b][i]7[/i][/b][i] [/i]extra characters in development that will have huge parts on Story Mode!  As a tease, here's the next character that is in development! Go check all the profiles in the Gallery to know more about them. All profiles were updated.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/24eee48dcdf370590570e59cc3990aba8a047dd6.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b](UPDATED AND NEW) MAPS[/b][/h2][p]All the maps have been reworked or updated to fit better the goal of showcasing all units. [/p][p]There a [b]5 pre-deployed maps[/b], showcasing all the mechanics and units an [b]5 Construction maps[/b] for you to play around and use what you learned.[/p][p][/p][h3][b](NEW)[/b] [b]MAPS PROGRESSION[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/38eb2695711fbcba55d1b49203a72dbe8d397167.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]For people first time playing the game, all maps are locked, except [b]Boot Camp[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Maps will unlock as you win the previous;[/p][list][*][p]example: Win Boot Camp to unlock the next: Avante Wars, etc...[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]After beating the 5th Pre-Deployed Map (Direct Line), the rest of the maps will unlock[/p][list][*][p]Meaning that you learned all the things the game has to offer![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If you want to skip that, since some people are already familiar with it:[/p][list][*][p]You can unlock all maps in the main menu with a special code done in the keyboard;[/p][/*][*][p]The code will be on our discord! :)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Pre-Deployed Maps[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) BOOT CAMP[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/6b290cfe1eff760afbe4365749bd4e2000214772.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Lesson: The basics, Movement, Capture, battles;[/p][/*][*][p]Units: [b]SCOUT, INFANTRY, BAZOOKA, TANK, GP;[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](UPDATED) AVANTE WARS[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/2252b7018fbbcc75a10a0f7bd2512dcf76756a27.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Lesson: Ranged, Status Effects and Splash Damage;[/p][/*][*][p]Units:[b] FLAME, SNIPER, MISSILES, ARTILLERY, DEFENDER, SCOUT;[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]
[b](NEW) HEAVY TRAFFIC[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/b7192cf8969d5ca4abb4fb817f581247ecf41830.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Lesson: Special Movement Units Mechanics;[/p][/*][*][p]Units:  [b]MAGNET, DRILL, RAM, SPIDER, HOVER, SCOUT[/b];[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) DESERT CLINIC[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/7321c4c9a9967cd3d84859e62200a1b53b39f769.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Lesson: Healing, Shock, Extra Burn, and Mega Splash Damage;[/p][/*][*][p]Units: [b]MEDIC, SHOCKER, INFERNO, MEGA, INFANTRY, SCOUT;[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b](NEW) DIRECT LINE[/b][/h3][p][img tags.feature: - ALL 20 UNITS are now available to play, both as the player and the AI:
- Reworked units:
- NEW UNITS
- UPDATED UNITS
(NEW) SHOCKER
(NEW) MEDIC
(NEW) LASER
(NEW) MAGNET
(NEW) MEGA
(UPDATED) DEFENDER
(UPDATED) FLAME
(UPDATED) INFERNO
(UPDATE) ARTILLERY
(NEW) SPLASH DAMAGE
Some units now deal splash damage;
ARTILLERY, MEGA and LASER;
SPLASH DAMAGE area is shown as a yellowish/orangeish area around the main target;
SPLASH DAMAGE will deal damage to all units inside the SPLASH DAMAGE area (similar to Armstrong Special);
SPLASH DAMAGE is based on total damage given to the main target.
During battle, units that deal SPLASH DAMAGE will spawn debris when attacking the target;
(NEW) BATTLE SPEED UP
Battles can be speed up by press and holding LMB, Spacebar or A (on Gamepad) after throwing the dice;
(UPDATED) D20 VISUAL
Our D20 Die got a updated visual;
Adjusted the + and - signs to be on top, so now they numbers are slightly bigger, making it easier to see on small screens (ex: laptops);
Dice has been slightly scaled up;
Removed the +- signs from 0s, since it didn't make sense;
(NEW) D6 BURN DIE
Burn Die: 33% chance (D6 2 faces out of 6) of giving BURN STATUS EFFECT to target!
Burn Die is automatically played when attacking with FLAME or INFERNO units;
(NEW) D6 SHOCK DIE
Shock Die: 15% (1/6) chance of giving SHOCK STATUS EFFECT to target!
Shock Die is automatically played when attacking with SHOCKER unit;
(BATTLE) MINOR UPDATES
Overall visual quality improved;
Burn and Shock dice have cool VFX;
Update Throw Bar visuals;
Fixed Lighting on the Dice Box;
Fixed Commander Cards to have some extra details;
(NEW) STATUS EFFECTS
Well, we had status effects before (Amara's Special Slow down), but now they are a full fledged system!
(UPDATED) SLOW DOWN
Status: SLOW DOWN
Any units with SLOW DOWN will have it's movement range reduced by 2!
Units with SLOW DOWN have a blue arrow pointing down on them;
Minimum movement range will be 1 (so units like Sniper (Movement Range 2) won't be fully rooted);
MAGNETs cannot receive SLOW DOWN, not even by Amara's Special;
SLOW DOWN can be given to enemies through:
Amara's Special (lasts 1 turn);
If you are adjacent to a enemy MAGNET.
Cannot be stacked;
SLOW DOWN can be removed if:
MAGNET unit is destroyed;
You move away from the MAGNET area;
(If Amara Special) After the turn ends;
(NEW) BURN
Status: BURN
BURNED units will receive 2 damage per tile walked
Staying in place will not deal damage;
Lasts 2 turns;
Units with BURN will have a small fire attached to them;
It's not stackable, but it can be reset if applied again;
FLAMEs and INFERNOs cannot receive BURN;
BURN is given by FLAME or INFERNO during battle with the BURN DIE;
BURN and INFERNOS cannot roll a BURN DIE when they are defending;
BURN is removed automatically after 2 turns;
(NEW) SHIELD
Status: SHIELD
Units with SHIELD have +10 Defense;
Units with SHIELD have the shimmering effect on them;
SHIELD is given automatically to any ally units adjacent to the DEFENDER unit;
Units in a plus shape, up to 4 units (above, below, left and right);
Cannot be stacked;
DEFENDERs cannot receive SHIELD;
SHIELD can only be removed if:
DEFENDER unit giving SHIELD dies;
If you or the DEFENDER move away from each other;
(NEW) SHOCK
Status: SHOCK
SHOCKED units won't be able to move, attack or counter-attack (last 1 turn);
It's not stackable;
SHOCKED units will become grayed out and have a small electricity sprite on them;
SHOCKERs cannot receive SHOCK;
SHOCK is given by SHOCKER unit during battle with the SHOCK DIE;
SHOCKERs cannot roll a SHOCK DIE when they are defending;
SHOCK is removed automatically after 1 turn;
(STATUS EFFECTS) EXTRAS
Besides seeing what STATUS EFFECT your unit has on the board, you can also check the Unit Info Card;
For fun here is what a unit with all STATUS EFFECTS looks like (although very rare, it could happen!)
(STATUS EFFECTS) FUTURE
There are plans for a couple extra STATUS EFFECTS;
(UPDATED AND NEW) ALL STRATEGISTS REVEALED
Meet our full cast! For the demo, only the 3 already in will be playable in custom matches. But Story Mode (Prologue) you will be able to play with almost all of them!

There are still 7 extra characters in development that will have huge parts on Story Mode! As a tease, here's the next character that is in development! Go check all the profiles in the Gallery to know more about them. All profiles were updated.
(UPDATED AND NEW) MAPS
All the maps have been reworked or updated to fit better the goal of showcasing all units.
There a 5 pre-deployed maps, showcasing all the mechanics and units an 5 Construction maps for you to play around and use what you learned.
(NEW) MAPS PROGRESSION
For people first time playing the game, all maps are locked, except Boot Camp;
Maps will unlock as you win the previous;
example: Win Boot Camp to unlock the next: Avante Wars, etc...
After beating the 5th Pre-Deployed Map (Direct Line), the rest of the maps will unlock
Meaning that you learned all the things the game has to offer!
If you want to skip that, since some people are already familiar with it:
You can unlock all maps in the main menu with a special code done in the keyboard;
The code will be on our discord! :)
(UPDATED) BOOT CAMP
(UPDATED) AVANTE WARS
(NEW) HEAVY TRAFFIC
(NEW) DESERT CLINIC
(NEW) DIRECT LINE
(NO CHANGE) LITTLE BRIDGES
(UPDATED) CAMP FEVER
(NEW) THE GREAT DIVIDE
(UPDATED) ECONOMY CLASS
(NEW) ISLAND MANAGEMENT
(NEW) BIGGER MAPS HAVE ZOOM
Bigger maps can be played with zoom or without it
Just press F or LT to toggle between zoom or whole board view;
GENERAL MINOR UPDATES
MAPS
Removed some bridges from Economy Class, otherwise Drills would be useless;
SPECIALS
Reiko's Special (Monopoly) got a rework: Now it captures all NEUTRAL Camps;
If used correctly can be devastating;
UNITS
UI
After the flashing warning, you can skip the intro by pressing LMB, ESC, SpaceBar or A (Gamepad)
Buying Units UI got a rework;
Now with more information about the units
New Units, Tiles and Status Effects Cheat Sheets on Pause menu;
New Map selection menu;
Are you still reading the post? props to you.
Comment which strategist/commander you think it's gonna win and conquer Atlantis!
so I'll know people are reading this!
The white outline on most cards (unit info, terrain info, money info, etc...) have been changed to dark-gray;
There is a new prompt if playing Online if a controller is disconnected. This helps if your friend disconnects in their turn and you need to go back to the main menu.

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, [b]Danilo[/b] here, creator of [b]Avante! Atlantis[/b][/p][p][/p][p]First of all, I'd like to thank everyone who played the demo, for all the feedback and love sent.
I've been developing [b]Avante! Atlantis solo[/b] for about [b]1 year[/b] now. When I mean solo, I mean [b]I do 90% of the project, while the others 10% I have help[/b] from friends and freelancers, so I want to publicly thank all the people who have helped me:[/p][list][*][p]Luiz Carlos de Gino for stylized [b]Character Designs[/b];[/p][list][*][p]Leo Ross for helping with [b]Character Emotions (Not yet in game!)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Roberta B. Giorgi for the cute [b]Nation Emblems Logos;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Guilherme Nogueira de Sá for helping me with [b]Character Profiles and Story;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Andreas Karnung for the awesome [b]Music;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Thami Nakamura for the wiggly [b]Characters Animations[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Karol Orttiz for [b]Amara and Reiko placeholder voices; (Not yet in game!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]And everyone else on our [b]discord! Love you guys [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][/list][p]
I'm closely reading everything and every feedback, so please, don't hesitate in sending one! I'm all ears and I want to make a better game together with the community.[/p][p][/p][p]Now without further ado, here is the change list for the [b]Demo 1.0.5[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]DEMO 1.0.5[/h1][h1][b]MAJOR UPDATES[/b][/h1][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Commander revealed![/h2][list][*][p]The youngest ever Chess Grand Master from the nation of Amethyst Tigers: [b]Vihaan Sharma[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]WHAT[/i][/b][i] a kid is doing for fighting for Atlantis? Doesn't make sense![/i] [/p][p][i]The battle for Atlantis is unlike any conflict the world has seen. This isn’t a war of strength - it’s a clash of brilliant minds. Only the sharpest strategists from each nation have been chosen. notes.title: Avante! Atlantis Updates! World Map, Defined Units and Commanders
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Just wanted to keep you updated on how development on Avante! Atlantis is going.

During January, I've been researching and trying to set up in stone some things.

And here are they:

- I'll do my best to finish the game [b]without[/b] story mode by the end of this year;
- There will be Multiplayer Local and Online, plus Single Player (Player vs Computer);
- Ideally we will have a map creator, but I'm leaving that for last;
- There will be a total of 8 Commanders, based on 8 Nations (which are Work in Progress);
- There will be a total of 20 Units. Naval and Air Units were removed due time constrains (but nothing stops me to add them in a later update or DLC);


On the World:
- There will be 8 teams/nations: Ruby Jaguars, Garnet Eagles, Jade Foxes, Opal Sharks, Sapphire Lions, 
Amethyst Tigers, Spinel Cobras and Obsidian Ravens;
- Here's a world map of the game. This will be more used on the Story Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/a793b0842c5ce2f1cf4a2a62dd0974d5c873e97b.png[/img]

On the Commanders:
- I'm still writing them, but we already have 1 totally defined and with art!

Meet Thaddeus Armstrong, General of the Army of the Garnet Eagles!
Ruthless, he will do anything to achieve his goal!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/179064fb0b453447130ced97424916f5dfde5885.png[/img]

On the Units:
- There game will feature this units, and this is the damage/defense chart of it, where: Dark Red is Useless, Red is Worst, Oragen is Bad, Yellow is Moderated (50%+-), Green is Good, Blue is Awesome and Pink is Overkill against it.
- Some of this arts are Placeholders, so don't worry about it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/0b701329cf42ca2747f3e95e48e0646d06b041a5.png[/img]

Here are the currently ones with almost/or already finished art:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/f2a726fdf9ca254d670a7f9f1760a54ca0803db1.png[/img]

And I think that's it for now. Development is going well, some people are helping me with some areas, so hopefully it all goes smooth!

Thanks, and [b]Avante[/b]!

tags.feature: - Removed the Desert Map, and replaced for a new map;
- Added the ARV Unit (only on the new map). Good on movement! But it can be obliterated by tanks and bazookas;
- Added a small pop-up display to show the amount of damage you will give and receive back;

notes.title: Early Access Demo Release Date

tags.feature: - [b]2-Player Games only[/b]. There will be no AI/Computer opponent at this stage;
- [b]Controller Only[/b] gameplay. I'm also working to see how I can implement keyboard gameplay with 2 local players;
- [b]Local Play and Remote Play Together only [/b]. Play via internet with other will come in a later update;
- Localization: Only [b]English[/b]. But I'll be working to add Portuguese-Brazil, Spanish, French and Japanese ASAP;
- 3 Maps;
- 3 Unit Types (Infantry, Bazooka and Tank);
- 2 ways of winning: Defeating all Units or Reaching the opponent HQ;
- Settings: Window Mode, Resolution, BGM/SFX/UI Sound Volumes;
- Accessibility: Color-blind Settings;
